title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Repeat Failure Uplift on Downtime Credits
content:
Repeated breakdowns on one Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement raise the downtime credit.

Repeat failures raise the credit: on an agreement carrying three or more malfunction reports the credit is multiplied by 1.20; on one carrying exactly two, by 1.10; on one carrying a single report, it is unchanged.

The count is the number of malfunction reports registered on the agreement. The credit is multiplied before it is rounded; the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Points of judgement

| Malfunction reports on the agreement | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 1 | 1 (unchanged) |
| 2 | 1.10 |
| 3 or more | 1.20 |

## Hypothetical figures (credit of 412.40 before the multiplier)

| Reports | Figure |
|---|---|
| 1 | 412.40 |
| 2 | 453.64 |
| 4 | 494.88 |
